description: Generate a Studocu quiz or mockExam from 1-10 project source artifacts. Waits up to ~3 minutes; returns artifact_id and external_id when created, status creating with external_id when persist is not yet visible, or outcome_unknown on client timeout or in-flight duplicate (check get-project-state before retrying). Optional idempotency_key is forwarded as Idempotency-Key; identical retries without a key still dedupe.

artifact_ids.description: One to ten unique source artifact IDs (studocu://project/{project_id}/source/{uuid}) to generate from.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key. Agent OS always sends Idempotency-Key to Alpha (this value, or a fingerprint of project/type/sources/instruction). Reuse with a different body is rejected.

instruction.description: Optional free-text hint for the generating agent (e.g. "focus on chapter 3").

project_id.description: UUID of the Studocu project that will own the new creation.

type.description: The kind of creation to generate: quiz or mockExam.

name: request-creation

artifact_id.description: Agent OS artifact ID of the new creation. Present when status is created.

external_id.description: Kind-specific downstream id (quizId or mockExamId). Present on created and creating; match the same field on get-project-state creation rows. Omitted on timeout.

status.description: created: persisted and linked (artifact_id and external_id). creating: generation finished but Alpha identity is not yet visible (external_id matches get-project-state creation rows). outcome_unknown: client timeout or an in-flight duplicate (check get-project-state; do not mint a new key). Terminal failures use MCP isError, not a status value.

title: Request Studocu Creation
